title: Apply reviewed migrations through existing Management API credentials in one atomic transaction

source.ref: Owner explicitly authorized secure push/merge/migrate automation. Existing dry-run43637695440 fails solely because SUPABASE_DB_URL is absent while the trusted readiness Management API credential works.

detail: The sanctioned main-only protected-environment workflow retains its admin-or-independent-head-review and GitHub Actions source checks, then uses a main-owned helper for both direct DB and canonical Frequency Community Management API transports. It verifies exact current main/head, trusted current-main readiness receipt and real evaluator provenance (actual one-or-two-job API shapes), complete reviewed source hashes/modes, migration hashes, unexpired registration, latest exact-head staging source/run/required replay-TAP-API-cleanup steps and production ledger. Final prewrite checks repeat bindings and latest provider facts. Only Git SQL blobs are read; no candidate JavaScript is installed or executed. Dry-run is the helper default and submits no writes. The official Management API read_only contract preserves raw SELECT results; non-2xx/unknown response shapes fail closed without exposing credentials or provider bodies. SQL and ledger insert share one transaction with advisory and exclusive ledger-table locks, exact in-transaction ledger assertion, local timeouts and no write retry. Conservative lexical parsing preserves quoted function bodies and strips only proven outer transactions; ambiguous ASCII/Unicode dollar identifiers, psql escapes and top-level controls refuse. The new immutable consequence probe fails on current main because apply-migration does not wire the existing Management API credential, then passes with the fallback and zero-query default dry-run. Focused protocol/security tests, independent source/provenance review and actual isolated PostgreSQL atomic rollback proofs are recorded after completion. No production migration dispatch, SQL application, feature activation, collector/publisher/registration/db-tests workflow edit, experiment source change, or existing test/probe/pin modification is included. Final local focused verification passes227 tests across5 files (39 new protocol/security cases plus unchanged readiness/publisher/migration/invocation suites), changed-file ESLint passes, and workflow contract passes. Root and independent provenance/security reviewers pass. Independent actual isolated PostgreSQL executes the final parser hash cff4b06c1062f1baa88f161149fb5ab2251819adbd57d5b15b5b6296d0e8aa56: body failures roll back DDL and ledger, successful DDL/ledger commit together, ledger-insert failure rolls back DDL, and ASCII/Unicode dollar-alias transaction escapes refuse. The actual reviewed analytics50000 SQL also commits successfully inside the wrapper with its exact ledger row in the isolated fixture. These are disposable local proofs, not live provider application. The official Management API OpenAPI contract confirms read_only and documented201 success; a real main-owned dry-run and actual application remain separate root-operated acceptance after publication. Required local check:backlog passes on the reviewed implementation with2699 entries and1006 agreeing probes, including the unchanged existing workflow/head-approval contracts. The immutable probe remains SHA25698f589c24354cea0dbef568503556457bb44488b38b58f935daa176e512a1e09. All actual provider write acceptance remains reserved for the root-operated main workflow after exact-head CI and publication.
